items.title: Devon Energy (NYSE:DVN) Reports Strong Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Oil and gas producer Devon Energy (NYSE:DVN) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 80.2% year on year to $7.42 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.57 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
